name: weawr
description: Watch Linear or GitHub Issues; when an issue matches a rule, open a herdr workspace, run a coding agent in a worktree, brief it, and report the PR back to the issue.

scripts.release: turbo run lint typecheck build && turbo run test --force && node scripts/verify-install.mjs && npm version patch && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: turbo run lint typecheck build && turbo run test --force && node scripts/verify-install.mjs && npm version minor && git push --follow-tags
